note: FR-831 / TC-2113. Every case names a COMPLETE published checked package of `packages` (a base fixture plus RFC 6902 `ops`, or a complete fixture file) and the `edit` that adds, or omits, the optional top-level member; each package is read by the existing strict reader without the member (receipts in the author report) and is schema-valid with it. No existing reader consumes the member (it refuses it `unknown_member`), so every `expect` is the contract's expected result of a reader that carries FR-831 and nothing in `positive`, `reader_refusals`, `budget` or `consumer` is executed by a reader; what tests/protocol_correlation_vectors.rs executes is data consistency: packages, schema, row keys and coverage computed from the packages, and a charge model recomputed from the packages and compared with every budget expectation. Packages hold real canonical related records (relationship Order-order-Order of acme/orders; ends are the over binder `view`, retyped to Reference<Order>, and the event binder `notified`, a Reference<Order>), source_map entries and dependencies obeying FR-464/FR-466. Row order follows FR-322 structural NodeRef order: package, then path segment by segment (shorter path first), then ordinal, then occurrence ordinal, then source_ordinal.

absent_by_standard.two_declaration_occurrences: FR-464 'occurrences': every occurrence of a protocol node has role declaration, one per declaring construct in the source; a control has one declaring construct, so no admitted protocol control has a second declaration occurrence. A vector with two occurrences of one control cannot be an admitted package and is not published; the occurrence join is exercised by a row naming ordinal 1 (CO-R08).

budget.meter: one caller-owned NativeJoinBudget, the budget of the strict read (filament-contract-ir FR-358): a work counter and a read-storage counter, cumulative across the strict read, every earlier join and this step, no reset, a denied charge consumes nothing; this contract adds no limit field and no counter
budget.baseline: B_work and B_storage are the consumption of each counter immediately before the step, measured on the same input; every limit below is stated as B plus an offset, never as a static total, because B depends on the strict read of the whole package

work_policy.row: 1 + B + L: one unit, B the UTF-8 byte length of control.package plus the byte length of every segment of control.path (an index segment counts the bytes of its decimal numeral), L the UTF-8 byte length of alias; charged before the row is inspected, rows in array order. The join resolution, the key comparison with the predecessor and the source_map lookup examine only this row's control text and alias, so B and L pay for them.
work_policy.scan: one charge per protocol/control node in ascending structural node-id order: 1 + Bn, Bn the byte length of the node id as B counts a NodeRef, plus O + m when the node is eligible (O its declaration occurrences, m its canonical related records); charged before the node is inspected, so every node-id comparison of the coverage walk is paid by the node it reads

storage_policy.groups: after the last row passes: one block for the typed view, one group record (control, occurrence, the borrowed whole source_map entry, the row span) per distinct (control, occurrence) key, requested with its full size G = groups x size_of(group record) and charged before it is requested; size_of is the native type's, so G is measured, not stated
storage_policy.flags: per eligible control node with m >= 1, in scan order: one block of m one-byte flags, m bytes, charged at that node after its scan charge and before it is requested
storage_policy.alias: borrowed from the retained document: no copy, no charge; a reader that copies an alias or a NodeRef text SHALL charge the copied bytes before the copy
storage_policy.source_map_entry: borrowed whole (every region): no copy, no charge
storage_policy.zero_size: a block of zero bytes is not charged
